system: perovskite SrTiO3; PBE; SSSP 1.3 precision pseudopotentials (Sr GBRV-1.2 ultrasoft with 4s4p semicore, Ti GBRV-1.4 ultrasoft with 3s3p semicore, O PSlibrary 0.3.1 PAW); fixed occupations; static lattice; Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and ph.x on 2 MPI ranks

fields.kind: "scf" (pw.x self-consistent run: total energy, forces, stress) or "dielectric" (scf plus the ph.x electric-field response at q = 0: electronic dielectric tensor and Born effective charges; undisplaced perovskite_5 cell only)
fields.cell: "perovskite_5": a1 = (a, 0, 0), a2 = (0, a, 0), a3 = (0, 0, c); atoms Sr (0,0,0), Ti (1/2,1/2,1/2), O_x (0,1/2,1/2), O_y (1/2,0,1/2), O_z (1/2,1/2,0) in fractions of (a, a, c). "rotated_10": the cell doubled at the R point, a1 = (0, a, c), a2 = (a, 0, c), a3 = (a, a, 0), two formula units: atoms 1-5 at the perovskite_5 sites, atoms 6-10 at the same sites shifted by (a, 0, 0)
fields.c_A: out-of-plane pseudocubic lattice parameter c (Angstrom); c = a for a cubic cell
fields.displacements_A: list with one Cartesian displacement [dx, dy, dz] (Angstrom) per atom, in the atom order of the cell, added to the ideal sites; all zeros for the undistorted cell
fields.ecutwfc_Ry: wavefunction cutoff (Ry); charge-density cutoff 8 x ecutwfc
fields.kmesh: n of the n x n x n Gamma-centred Monkhorst-Pack mesh in the reciprocal basis of the chosen cell

charge.rule: scf: units = max(1, ceil(N_k * scf_k_point_weight[cell] * cutoff_factor[ecutwfc])), where N_k is the number of symmetry-distinct k points of the mesh for the displaced cell (returned as charged_k_points; it grows as displacements lower the symmetry). dielectric: units = ceil(dielectric[kmesh] * cutoff_factor[ecutwfc] * N_k / dielectric_cubic_k_points[kmesh]). Requests above max_units_per_request are refused without charge. Failed jobs stay charged.

result_units.total_energy_Ry: Ry per cell (the rotated_10 cell holds two formula units)
result_units.forces_Ry_per_bohr: Cartesian forces on every atom, in the cell's atom order
result_units.stress_GPa: pw.x sign convention (positive when compressed); pressure_GPa is its trace / 3
result_units.born_charges_raw: per atom, units of e, [field direction][force direction] (dF/dE), no charge-neutrality sum rule imposed
